dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: Do you know what we researchers fear the most?

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: We fear the loss of research direction, that's what!

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: Perhaps my luck is just terrible, but there is presently no need to pursue the topic that I was originally looking into.

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: And here I was looking to make a name for myself by solving a major problem... and would you look at that? It's all come to nothing!

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: This should be a time of opportunity! Four out of our six sage seats are empty! And here I am...

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: No. No, I can't give up just yet. They're not just going to flip a coin and pick a sage just like that!

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: As long as I can find a research topic more important and with more potential than the last, I've still got a chance...
